song.name: Empire of the Void
song.plot: The song serves as an anthem to the 'Empire of the Void,' a vast and powerful realm of eternal night ruled by the newly awakened ancient evil, Nychtoros. The lyrics describe a kingdom forged in darkness, where its legions embrace the silence and find strength in a destiny bound to their dark regime. It's a declaration of the Empire's supreme, cosmic power and its inhabitants' unwavering belief in their enduring legacy.
song.analysis: The original lyrics are atmospheric but generic. The production-ready version was human-reviewed to thread Nyktoros into the existing structure surgically, keeping the original's imagery and rhythm intact while anchoring the song to his awakening.

verse.original: In the shadow of the night, where the stars refuse to glow, A kingdom forged in darkness, where the ancient whispers flow. Rising from the ashes of a world that once was bright, A symphony of silence in the everlasting night.
verse.adapted: In the shadow of the night, where the stars begin to dim, The age of light is ending soon, on Nyktoros's whim. From his deep slumber he will rise, a world once pure and bright, Will fall into his endless void, an everlasting night.

pre-chorus.original: Beyond the edge of time and space, where legends dare to dream, A force beyond imagining, where nothing’s what it seems.
pre-chorus.adapted: A name that’s whispered soft in fear, a legend born of dread, A shadow crawling ever near, to raise the sleeping dead.

chorus.original: In the Empire of the Void, where shadows reign supreme, We’re bound by chains of destiny, within this dark regime. A realm where echoes linger, where silence speaks in screams, In the Empire of the Void, we live within our dreams.
chorus.adapted: In the Empire of the Void, where shadows reign supreme, We're bound by chains of shadow now, within his waking dream. A realm where terror lingers, where silence softly screams, In the Empire of the Void, built on forgotten dreams.

verse.original: Eclipsing suns and galaxies, our power knows no bounds, Eternal night embraces all, in darkness, we are crowned. Through cosmic storms and nebulas, our legions march as one, An empire built on silence, beneath a blackened sun.
verse.adapted: He darkens suns and galaxies, his power has no bounds, His endless night embraces all, on consecrated grounds. Through cosmic storms and nebulas, his legions march as one, An empire from nothingness, beneath a dying sun.

bridge.original: Through the endless dark, we rise, our spirits never fade, In the heart of nothingness, our legacy is made. We conquer through the silence, our banners waving high, In the Empire of the Void, where stars go to die.
bridge.adapted: From out the endless dark he'll rise, his essence will not fade, Upon a throne of nothingness, a fearsome king is made. He conquers with just silence, his banners flying high, In the Empire of the Void, where all the stars will die.

verse.original: As the final light extinguishes, we embrace the endless night, In the Empire of the Void, we find our strength and might. Through the silence, we are rulers, in the darkness, we are free, In the Empire of the Void, our reign will ever be.
verse.adapted: As the final light extinguishes, we praise the endless night, Inside his Empire of the Void, he is our guiding light. Through utter silence we are ruled, in darkness we are free, In Nyktoros's great empire, our reign will ever be.

outro.original: Through the endless dark, we rise, our spirits never fade, In the heart of nothingness, our legacy is made. We conquer through the silence, our banners waving high, In the Empire of the Void, where stars go to die.
outro.adapted: From out the endless dark he'll rise, his essence will not fade, Upon a throne of nothingness, a fearsome king is made. He conquers with just silence, his banners flying high, In the Empire of the Void, where all the stars will die.
